facts.snippet: Our largest customer in 2023, 2024 and 2025 accounted for 25%, 22% and 19% of our net revenue in the respective year.
facts.note: Share of TSMC 2025 net revenue. The financial-statement note lists Customer A at NT$726,974.3 million, 19% in 2025 (12% in 2024, under 10% in 2023): the trajectory matches Nvidia per press reports, but the filing does not name it.

facts.snippet: Our second largest customer in 2023, 2024 and 2025 accounted for 11%, 12%, and 17% of our net revenue in the respective year.
facts.note: Share of TSMC 2025 net revenue. The financial-statement note lists Customer B at NT$645,178.7 million, 17% in 2025 (22% in 2024, 25% in 2023): the trajectory matches Apple per press reports, but the filing does not name it.

facts.snippet: our ten largest customers in 2023, 2024 and 2025 accounted for approximately, 70%, 76% and 78% of our net revenue
facts.note: Ten largest customers, share of 2025 net revenue.

facts.snippet: Our capital expenditures in 2026 are expected to be between US$52 billion and US$56 billion
facts.note: Midpoint of the stated range. Stated in the 20-F filed April 2026; may since have been revised on an earnings call.
